backlog.what: A session that does step 2 at ~15:30 ET Tuesday and then stops (step 5, the handoff skill) pushes to main before 18:00 ET. Under G-003 that push redeploys ced-api on a Phase 1 measurement day, near the 16:15 and 18:00 ET special-filing slots. The page gives no timing caution, although earlier pushes were timed between slots on purpose.
backlog.where: HANDOFF.md:37-38 "do the ones whose data exists, write what is still waiting into the session's PROGRESS entry (step 5), and stop there" + HANDOFF.md:55 step 5, vs PROGRESS.md #8 "it was sent at about 10:40 ET, between the 08:45 and 11:15 ET Public Inspection slots" and docs/design/P2.2.md §4.1 header "none inside a measurement window"
